entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message requesting deactivation of an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer of last PDN connection
entities.description: Condition where the EPS bearer to be deactivated is the default bearer of the UE's last PDN connection.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported
entities.description: Condition indicating both UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without any active PDN connection.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not supported
entities.description: Condition indicating either UE or MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED state without any active PDN connection.

entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE to detach from the network.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE to attach to the network.

entities.name: Deactivation procedure
entities.description: Procedure for deactivating an EPS bearer context as specified in clause 6.4.4.3.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: The DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is evaluated against the condition of being the default bearer of the last PDN connection.
If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, the UE shall perform a detach procedure.
If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, the UE should perform an attach procedure.
If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported, the UE shall proceed with the deactivation procedure.
The detach procedure is performed when the UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state.
